proxy_note: The book cache has top-of-book prices only (no sizes), so depth OBI and microprice are not computable. Proxies: flow = 10s signed print-flow imbalance (+ = takers buying YES); rev = 5s touch-revision imbalance (+ = bid upticks dominate). Each is z-scored per lane on that lane's IS rows (population std, valid rows only: z != 0, finite sigma, flow and rev finite): z_obi = (x - mean) / std, applied to every row.
